name: element_snapshot_tool
description: Designer Tool - Element snapshot tool to perform actions like get element snapshot. helpful to get element snapshot for debugging and more and visual feedback.

siteId.description: Webflow site ID. Use list_sites to discover site IDs.

component.description: Pass element.id.component verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

element.description: Pass element.id.element verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

id.description: The `id` object of a Designer element — two fields, not a single string. Copy it verbatim from the tool result that returned the element.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.
